proposal.reason: Main change is CI workflow execution behavior: `.github/workflows/build-artifactory-ppu.yml` adds authenticated registry login before image pull and introduces label/instant-based commit pinning for dispatch/schedule builds, while `.github/workflows/source-sanity.yml` and `.github/workflows/pccl-daily-full.yml` switch `pccl-tests` checkout from fixed SHA to ref-paired branch resolution with fallback and propagate resolved revisions through cache/validation steps. Supporting updates in `.github/xtest/artifact_cache.py` and `test_workflow_contract.py` only align CI fixture/revision checks with that runtime resolution contract, so no separate module is independently substantive.
